facts.claim: Tardigrades can withstand extreme temperatures, vacuum, and radiation.
facts.quote: Tardigrades can survive exposure to extreme temperatures, extreme pressures (both high and low), air deprivation, radiation, dehydration, and starvation – that would quickly kill most other forms of life.

facts.claim: In 2007, samples of 30 tardigrades and 30 eggs, all dehydrated, were taken on the FOTON-M3 mission and exposed to vacuum, to both vacuum and UVA & B light, or to both vacuum and the full range of solar ultraviolet, for 10 days.
